thread:
maya: heads up — nightly eval failed on quantized-int4 model, lots of truncated outputs and weird replacement chars \uFFFD in generations
liam: ugh, saw that in the alerts. any logs?
maya: paste from eval-bundle: `2026-03-19T02:12:05Z watchdog: killing worker pid=8421 after 120s wall timeout` then generation file `runs/2026-03-19/modelA/seq-42.json` contains half a JSON and then a bunch of NULs
anya: interesting — watchdog kills, but should be a graceful SIGTERM -> dump then SIGKILL. logs show immediate SIGKILL?
maya: exact line: `kill -9 8421` in watchdog codepath, not the graceful path.
devex: can you paste the command we run for the harness?
maya: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model modelA-quant-int4 --seed 42 --workers 8 --prompt-set prompt_v2`
liam: repro locally with same args?
maya: trying now on my devbox (GPU emu), still see the watchdog trigger intermittently at ~119s, sometimes not. non-deterministic.
eval-bot: nightly-eval/2026-03-19 failed 7/102 prompts (regression + flaky truncation)
anya: could be sampling hotspots causing longer wall time on quantized kernel, or a harness loop stalled on I/O. we saw fd_wait issues before.
liam: my hunch: watchdog uses time.time() (wall) but comparisons against monotonic timers elsewhere -> can miscalculate when system clock jumps, but that wouldn't cause consistent ~119s timeout unless there's blocking I/O.
maya: logs show `read(9, ...)` blocking in `RecordWriter` right before kill. file descriptor 9 is the gzip writer to S3 stream.
devex: we recently changed gzip flush behavior in artifact upload PR #784. could be related.
anya: assigning oncall to triage S3 writer path. @liam can you instrument the RecordWriter to emit a heartbeat every 10s and dump stack on block?
liam: will do. quick patch to add `if now - last_heartbeat > 10: log.debug("heartbeat", stack=... )` and a non-blocking flush path. sending PR in a bit.
maya: also collecting the corrupted run bundle: s3://redwood-nightlies/2026-03-19/modelA/ -> downloaded to /tmp/modelA-corrupt.tar.gz
anya: can you try running the harness with env WATCHDOG_DISABLE=1 and WATCHDOG_GRACE=300 so we can see if the generation finishes?
maya: started a run with WATCHDOG_DISABLE=1 and same args. currently at 3/102 prompts, no truncation so far.
devex: that is suggestive. if disabling watchdog stops truncation, maybe the kill was racing with writer flush and leaving a partial file.
liam: still not convinced it's purely writer. the kill path uses `os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)` without waiting for in-flight uploads to close. we should coordinate shutdown.
anya: short-term mitigation: change watchdog to send SIGTERM, wait 10s, then SIGKILL. add a pre-kill hook to request workers to finish current write and flush.
liam: opened issue #1098: `watchdog: avoid hard-kill during artifact uploads` and started PR branch `watchdog-graceful-shutdown`.
maya: stack dump from blocked worker (attached): shows `gzip.GzipFile.write` stuck inside `zlib.compressobj.compress` -> underlying C code.
devex: zlib can block if Python GIL held and another thread stalls on network write (rare). if our uploader is single-threaded per worker, a SIGKILL can leave partial gzip stream. S3 multipart requires consistent parts.
anya: add checksum validation on the consumer side: if artifact JSON parse fails, mark example as failed but don't overwrite generation file. we also need to surface partial bytes to devs.
liam: Plan: 1) instrument RecordWriter heartbeat (in PR) 2) change watchdog signal sequence (in PR) 3) run a controlled nightly with WATCHDOG_GRACE=300 and collect core/stackdumps 4) postmortem if replicated.
maya: I'll run a narrow repro across 20 seeds with WATCHDOG_GRACE=300 and quantized kernels toggled. results ETA ~45m.
anya: @devex please coordinate a rollback of gzip change if the PRs don't confirm. Also grab the debug bundle from the runner that had corrupted output (I put it at /tmp/modelA-corrupt.tar.gz).
devex: ack, starting rollback playbook step if needed.
sre-bot: deploy job watchdog-graceful-shutdown started by liam — CI queued
liam: CI flaky on mac build, rerunning.
maya: local repro with WATCHDOG_DISABLE=1 succeeded for 20/20, with watchdog enabled we saw 3/20 truncations. looks correlated.
anya: good signal. next steps: liam and I will review PRs, devex will run staged nightly with updated watchdog, maya will keep collecting failing bundles. update channel when PRs merge. :thumbsup:
liam: tagging owners: @runtime-team for kernel/IO path, @eng-infra for s3 uploader library review.
maya: thanks team — will paste failing IDs in case anyone wants to dig (run ids: 2026-03-19-1a2b ... 1a2d).
eval-bot: nightly-eval scheduled re-run with watchdog-graceful-shutdown branch (ci)
anya: closing loop: if anyone finds more truncated outputs in non-quantized runs, flag here. could be broader but current signal points to artifact flush + watchdog race.
maya: noted. adding a small test to harness that injects a sleep during artifact upload to ensure watcher doesn't hard-kill.
liam: PR #1101 opened: graceful shutdown + pre-kill hook. please review.
anya: thanks — assigning post-fix verification to maya and devex.
